milestone: Fase 1-D — caches LRU de metadata relacionada de Trakt e Simkl no Desktop

change.implementation: One synchronized timed LRU expires entries on access, refreshes access recency without refreshing TTL, removes forced-refresh entries, and evicts the least-recently-used key over capacity. Existing provider response and empty-result handling remain unchanged.

limitations: The MSI is an alpha-labelled local validation artifact and is not a stable release; it was not published.
The Android TV repository was not changed by this Desktop-only increment.
Entry-count limits are not exact heap-byte budgets; no physical-PC heap, CPU, jank, Trakt/Simkl network, or offline-flow measurement was performed.
Stable release v1.0.13 remains unchanged. Login and authentication were not changed; the app continues to use the Nuvio login flow.
